scope: Biotin-labeled proteins were purified using streptavidin beads and digested with trypsin for subsequent enrichment of diGly peptides with diGly antibody-conjugated beads.
The biotinylated-ubiquitinated proteins were purified from HeLa cells transfected with constructs encoding FLAG-BirA-RNF8 and AP-HA-Ub using previously described methods.
The biotinylated-ubiquitinated proteins immobilized on beads were reduced, alkylated, trypsinized, and then purified by Ubiquitin Branch Motif (K-ϵ-GG) affinity purification procedure

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The mass spectrometry analysis was performed on material subjected to two stages of affinity purification: first, streptavidin beads to capture biotinylated proteins, and second, K-ϵ-GG immunoaffinity beads to enrich for ubiquitinated peptides.
